sources.comoving_direct: power reconstructed from full native CLASS-compatible comoving density using direct synchronous v_b
sources.comoving_recovered: same transformation using Newtonian-subtracted velocity, retained as a diagnostic
sources.synchronous_native: power reconstructed from full native synchronous delta_tot
sources.log_cubic: previous same-run CAMB log-cubic power on aligned native k
sources.previous_frozen_log_linear: old 2500-point output after its second log-linear resampling
sources.class_integral: CLASS integral pk.dat with default gauge-invariant comoving delta_m

methods.raw: log-log interpolation to the common grid, no smoothing
methods.smooth_0.05dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P) with sigma=0.05 dex before band integration
methods.smooth_0.10dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P) with sigma=0.10 dex before band integration

boundaries: The explicit gauge mapping is now included in both model spectra before integration and model ratios.
Differences between direct and recovered velocities are numerical diagnostics, not observational errors.
CLASS/CAMB recombination, perturbation implementation, sampling and smoothing systematics remain independent.
No likelihood, parameter search, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
